column3: The little fox carried a red apple through the forest, looking for someone to share it with. Near the stream, she heard a soft laugh.
A paper boat sailed along the gutter after the storm. Eli followed it down the street, hoping it would reach the garden pond safely.
At the edge of the meadow, a wooden sign pointed toward a place called Sunny Hill. Priya packed a snack and invited her brother along.
The baker noticed a golden feather beside the flour sack. He placed it on the counter and wondered which visitor had left it there.
